normative_plan: Audit at /tmp/pantheon-dependency-audit-20260927/REPORT.zh-TW.md; narrow implementation prerequisite extracted from LOOP-RECEIPT-INTEGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001; re-opened to resolve Codex2 review defects

implementation.summary: Scope existing twelve-loop receipt schema and durable store with explicit tenant_id and environment before producer/read integration. Preserves honest legacy unscoped rows without invented provenance, enforces zero cross-tenant leakage, isolates unscoped legacy reduction from scoped partitions, provides non-lossy 002 rollback and pre-003 source compatibility, and establishes fresh-process restart and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.current_fix: Forward migration 003 adds nullable tenant_id and environment columns to loop_receipts and twelve_loop_observations with NULLS NOT DISTINCT unique index. Fixed reviewer P1 defect 1 by preserving and isolating scoped loop_receipts (via loop_receipts_scoped_backup) as well as observations (via twelve_loop_observations_scoped_backup) during both sync and async rollback entrypoints (rollback_to_002_schema_sync and rollback_to_002_schema), dropping scoped indexes, restoring the twelve_loop_observations_pkey constraint, and verifying actual pre-003 store and projector read/rebuild/write behavior where legacy loops remain incomplete without scoped pollution. Re-applying migration 003 forward cleanly restores backed-up scoped receipts and observations. Fixed reviewer P1 defect 2 by replacing the hard-coded external /tmp artifact with a reproducible pinned pre-003 source fixture established by the test from base commit 3bb04edb292a171457c49bc608104c3d2174e704 inside declared scope. Fixed reviewer P2 defect 3 by verifying child-process restart, multi-tenant/environment isolation, and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.regressions: PostgreSQL migration 002-to-003 upgrade and honest legacy row preservation, unscoped legacy reduction isolation from tenant receipts, non-lossy rollback to 002 and pre-003 source compatibility, fresh-process child-process restart and rebuild equivalence, multi-tenant streaming, cross-tenant collision rejection, out-of-order delivery with provenance fencing, and failed persistence error handling.
implementation.boundary: Scoped receipt schema, storage, and read models only; no hosted deployment, no production-data migration, no credential changes, no second store or projector.
implementation.rollback_plan: Execute rollback_to_002_schema_sync() or await rollback_to_002_schema(): archives scoped receipts to loop_receipts_scoped_backup, archives scoped observations to twelve_loop_observations_scoped_backup, drops scoped indexes, and restores twelve_loop_observations_pkey on (release_id, correlation_id, loop_id). Allows pre-003 store and projector code to run with complete receipt and observation isolation without UniqueViolation or InvalidColumnReference. Forward re-migration 003 automatically restores all backed-up scoped receipts and observations without data loss.

verification.collection: Every listed batch was run in bounded foreground execution and terminal exit status was collected.
limitations: Parent LOOP-RECEIPT-INTEGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001 retains all genuine producer ingestion and mounted authenticated read wiring and 12-loop coverage.
No hosted deployment or live/capital-affecting write was performed; verification conducted against isolated containerized PostgreSQL 16.

acceptance_check.non_lossy_rollback_and_pre003_compat: Non-lossy rollback archives scoped rows to backup table and restores 002 pkey constraint, enabling pre-003 store operations without errors, and restoring on re-migration; verified in test_postgres_non_lossy_rollback_to_002_and_pre003_source_compatibility
acceptance_check.durable_store_and_rebuild_equivalence: Multi-tenant streaming, fresh child-process restart, and incremental-vs-rebuild equivalence verified in test_postgres_fresh_process_restart_and_rebuild_equivalence
acceptance_check.collision_and_tampering_rejection: Conflicting receipt identity and scope mismatches rejected with ValueError; verified in unit and postgres integration tests
acceptance_check.out_of_order_and_provenance_fencing: Provenance fencing and out-of-order receipt reduction preserved under scope; verified in test_postgres_scoped_out_of_order_and_provenance_fencing
